text: マサラタウンで　おちゃと　いえば…　ナナミさんが　まいにち　こうちゃを　のんでるね　タマムシデパートに　たまに　おちゃを　かいにくるよ

structure.jp: マサラタウンで　おちゃと　いえば…
structure.en: speaking of tea in Pallet Town...

structure.jp: ナナミさんが　まいにち　こうちゃを　のんでるね
structure.en: Daisy drinks black tea every day

structure.jp: タマムシデパートに　たまに　おちゃを　かいにくるよ
structure.en: she sometimes comes to the Celadon Department Store to buy tea

patterns.name: 〜といえば
patterns.explanation: といえば after a word brings it up as the topic, like 'speaking of'. おちゃと　いえば = 'speaking of tea'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb cut down to its stem plus に, before a verb of coming or going, says what you come or go to do. かいにくる = 'comes to buy'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows something done as a habit; here it is shortened to てる, as in casual talk. のんでる = 'drinks regularly'.
